claim:
REQ-513's dispatch-level rejection guard (spec-review iteration-2's own FIND-103 fix) checks a fabricated/off-menu slot against the WRONG reference set — the static, wake-level `ctx.alwaysActMenu` — instead of the narrower, per-attempt enum that was ACTUALLY offered in the tool schema for that specific think() call. This silently reopens exactly the money-safety hole FIND-101's fix (REQ-506's risk-safe-only reroute filter) was written to close: a model that ignores/defies the reroute's narrower schema (a realistic risk this SAME spec pair already establishes for weak/free models via parse-tool-call.mjs's scavenge/repair parser, cited as evidence for FIND-103 itself) can simply re-emit the just-picked OR any capital-risking slot during the REQ-506 reroute call, and REQ-513's guard will NOT reject it, because that slot is still a member of the full `ctx.alwaysActMenu` (it was only excluded from THIS ONE reroute attempt's tool schema, not from the menu as a whole). The rejected call falls through unchanged into normal skill EXECUTION (index.mjs's existing `runSkillWithKillRef(slot, args, ...)` path) — meaning a real capital-risking trade can actually FIRE, silently, with no error/ledger signal distinguishing it from a legitimate on-menu pick, defeating REQ-506's own advertised 'genuine hard tool-enum exclusion' promise at exactly the dispatch layer that was supposed to make it real (not merely a pure-function-level guarantee).

Concretely: REQ-504 point 1 (behavioral-spec.md:210-212) defines `ctx.alwaysActMenu` as a STATIC WakeContext field set ONCE per wake ('gains two additive fields set by index.mjs's wake loop ... only populated when alwaysActEngaged is true') — I independently verified via runtime/loop/context.mjs:26-53 (assembleContext) that WakeContext is assembled once, per-wake, from pre-loaded data with no per-attempt/per-retry mutation mechanism described anywhere in this spec pair or the existing codebase. REQ-506's reroute (behavioral-spec.md:283-285) instead builds a DIFFERENT, NARROWER, per-attempt tool schema: `buildAlwaysActToolDefinitions(menuSlots.filter(x => x !== s && isMarketRiskFree(x)))` — this narrower set is never assigned back to `ctx.alwaysActMenu` (no such reassignment is described), so it cannot be the reference REQ-513 checks against. Yet REQ-513's EARS clause (behavioral-spec.md:479) explicitly says the check is 'slot is not a member of ctx.alwaysActMenu (the offered enum for this wake)' — calling the STATIC full-wake menu 'the offered enum for this wake', which is simply false during a reroute attempt (the offered enum for THAT attempt is the filtered subset, not the full menu). verification-architecture.md's `isRejectableSleepOrOffMenu(slot, alwaysActMenu)` (lines 53-57) and PROP-513a (line 139) both repeat the same static-`ctx.alwaysActMenu`-only check and neither's acceptance-criteria/test description ever exercises 'a slot excluded from the CURRENT reroute schema but still present in the full always-act menu' — REQ-513's own two acceptance criteria (behavioral-spec.md:498-507) test only (a) `slot:'sleep'` and (b) a slot absent from the FULL `ctx.alwaysActMenu` (e.g. `'report'`), never the reroute-narrower-exclusion case. An implementer following REQ-513/PROP-513a exactly as specified will build `isRejectableSleepOrOffMenu(slot, ctx.alwaysActMenu)` — which is satisfied (returns false, i.e. NOT rejected) for a re-picked just-excluded or capital-risking slot during a reroute, because that slot IS a member of the full menu.
evidence: behavioral-spec.md:210-212 (ctx.alwaysActMenu defined as a single static, wake-level WakeContext field, 'only populated when alwaysActEngaged is true' — no per-attempt update mechanism described); behavioral-spec.md:283-285 (REQ-506's reroute schema is a DIFFERENT, narrower, one-off filtered array — `menuSlots.filter(x => x !== s && isMarketRiskFree(x))` — never assigned to ctx.alwaysActMenu); behavioral-spec.md:479 (REQ-513 EARS: 'slot is not a member of ctx.alwaysActMenu (the offered enum for this wake)' — conflates the static full-wake menu with the actually-offered per-attempt enum); behavioral-spec.md:498-507 (REQ-513's own two acceptance criteria test only slot:'sleep' and an off-full-menu slot like 'report'; neither tests a slot excluded from the reroute's narrower schema but present in the full menu); verification-architecture.md:53-57 (`isRejectableSleepOrOffMenu(slot, alwaysActMenu)` — same static-menu-only signature); verification-architecture.md:139 (PROP-513a's description: '{slot:'sleep', args:{}} (or any slot absent from ctx.alwaysActMenu)' — same gap, repeated in the formal proof obligation); independently verified ground truth: runtime/loop/context.mjs:26-53 (assembleContext is a pure, one-shot, per-wake function — no per-attempt/per-retry context-mutation API exists in the current codebase for a narrower 'currently offered' enum); runtime/loop/parse-tool-call.mjs:106-138 (the existing scavenge/repair parser — cited by this SAME spec's own FIND-103 evidence as proof that weak/free models realistically ignore the offered tool schema — extracts `slot`/`args` purely from response text/JSON with zero cross-check against which tools were actually offered, confirming a model CAN and realistically WILL emit a slot outside the currently-offered-but-inside-the-full-menu set).
required_fix: REQ-513 (and/or REQ-506) must check the fabricated/off-menu slot against the ACTUAL enum offered for THAT SPECIFIC think() call attempt, not the static wake-level ctx.alwaysActMenu. Concretely: introduce a per-attempt 'currently offered slots' value (e.g. a local variable in index.mjs's retry loop, distinct from ctx.alwaysActMenu, updated to the narrower REQ-506 reroute-filtered set for that specific call) and change REQ-513's EARS clause + isRejectableSleepOrOffMenu's signature to take that per-attempt value (not ctx.alwaysActMenu) as its second argument. Add a new/updated acceptance criterion and PROP (e.g. PROP-513b) asserting: given a REQ-506 reroute in flight whose narrower schema excludes the just-picked slot `s` (and every risk:'capital' slot), a parsed tool call of `{slot: s, args:{}}` (or any excluded-but-still-in-ctx.alwaysActMenu capital slot) fed to the REAL index.mjs dispatch during that reroute attempt is REJECTED — no skill execution occurs for that slot, and the wake proceeds to REQ-508's escalation (since the shared retry budget is exhausted after a reroute attempt) rather than silently executing a capital-risking trade the router explicitly tried to exclude.
